title: Achieving Routine Intervention and Screening for Emotional Health
official: ARISE: Achieving Routine Intervention and Screening for Emotional Health: Randomized Controlled Trial
summary: The purpose of this project is to evaluate the effectiveness of diabetes distress screening and intervention on patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM).

interventions.name: ARISE Learning Community Diabetes Distress Screening and Intervention

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patient at a participating clinic
* Type 2 diabetes
* Adult (18 years or older)
* A1C \> 8%
* English- or Spanish-speaking

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant
